causal_boundary.observed: A native picture returned by successful GetPicture receives WaitForBuffer -1 and OutputPicture AGAIN. Before any AddVideoPicture entry for that picture, a new successful GetPicture replaces it with the next native picture on the same TID and VideoPicture address.
causal_boundary.source_supported_mechanism: Pending AGAIN retry is in the MSGQ_TIMEOUT branch. GetMessage clears transient onlyPrioMsgs; priority message handling can allow a subsequent ordinary packet. The packet path calls AddData then ProcessDecoderOutput/GetPicture without an independent pending-AGAIN guard. This is a compatible source path, not a traced identification of the exact intervening message.
